provenance.asset_description: Two illustrations overlayed over a blurred background. In the top left corner is a corpsefolk wearing the uniform of an officer in the Corpse Fleet casts a spell, sending a disk of condensed gravity flying through the air. She wears her stringy hair up in a tight bun and keeps her uniform pristine. Some of her teeth and a piece of her mandible are visible through the gaps in her rotting cheek. In the bottom right corner is a blue-skinned sprite with dragonfly wings flutters agilely. She holds a magical staff, and is dressed in greens and golds.
